data.one_liner: Prevents screenshots and background data leakage on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to protect sensitive user data by blocking screenshots and screen recordings, or by masking the app preview with colors, images, or blur when sent to the background.
use_when: Building banking, fintech, or health applications that handle sensitive user data
Preventing app preview snapshots from appearing in the iOS app switcher
avoid_when: Your application does not handle sensitive or private user information
You only target desktop or web platforms
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms
Provides flexibility on iOS to blur, color, or show an image when backgrounded
weaknesses: Platform-specific behaviors and APIs may require manual native lifecycle wiring on certain OS versions
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific initialization code for Android and iOS as described in the README.
